parts.name: Cabinet Door (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower cabinet door of the tall storage cabinet, made of MDF with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lower storage compartment and protects contents from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper cabinet door of the tall storage cabinet, made of MDF with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the upper storage compartment and conceals stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of plywood for rigidity and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts including doors and shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structural component.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items placed in the lower section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower-Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower-middle shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items in the lower-middle section.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet space and supports stored items.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper-Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper-middle shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items in the upper-middle section.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed near the top of the cabinet and may also serve as a divider for the upper compartment.
